touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Hawarden qualifies as a local detour through Greenacres Animal Park and Parish Church of St Deinol. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Hawarden: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
